record.field: # MO - Link/Unlink Toggle: Smart action that detects current state and toggles link # If MOs are linked (origin matches SO name) -> Unlink them # If no MOs are linked -> Search and link MOs with matching origin # Check if MRP module is installed try: mrp_production = env['mrp.production'] except KeyError: raise UserError("Manufacturing (MRP) module is not installed. Please install it first.") # Find MOs where origin (Source field) matches this SO's name linked_mos = mrp_production.search([ ('origin', '=', record.name), ('state', '!=', 'cancel') ]) if linked_mos: # === UNLINK MODE: MOs are currently linked, so unlink them === mo_names = [] for mo in linked_mos: mo_names.append(mo.name) mo.write({'origin': False}) # Add chatter message in MO so_link = f"{record.name}" mo.message_post(body=f"Unlinked from Sales Order {so_link}") # Trigger recomputation to update smart button record._compute_mrp_production_ids() # Log in Sales Order mo_links = ', '.join([f"{mo.name}" for mo in linked_mos]) record.message_post(body=f"Unlinked {len(linked_mos)} Manufacturing Order(s): {mo_links}") action = { 'type': 'ir.actions.client', 'tag': 'display_notification', 'params': { 'title': 'MOs Unlinked', 'message': f"Successfully unlinked {len(linked_mos)} Manufacturing Order(s):\n" + "\n".join(mo_names), 'type': 'success', 'sticky': False, } } else: # === LINK MODE: No MOs linked, show instructions === # User needs to first set the Source field in MO to match SO name action = { 'type': 'ir.actions.client', 'tag': 'display_notification', 'params': { 'title': 'No MOs to Link/Unlink', 'message': f"No Manufacturing Orders found with Source = '{record.name}'.\n\nTo link MOs:\n1. Open the Manufacturing Order\n2. Go to Miscellaneous tab\n3. Set Source field to '{record.name}'\n4. Click this action again to confirm the link", 'type': 'warning', 'sticky': True, } }
